findings.status: confirmed by complete source and caller reading; no execution
findings.title: Fresh DNS publication can be mislabeled as a stored cache answer
findings.cause: Answer::Wait combines a locked stored-entry decision with newly started/shared resolution. After spawning concurrent work, lookup_noting_cache infers stored from receiver.borrow().is_some(), so completion before that borrow yields true for a lookup that performed resolution.
findings.consequence: connect_tcp_with_lookup gives a true stored flag ZERO extra HTTPS/ECH record wait rather than the fresh lookup allowance clamped to 5..50ms. A fast answer can therefore change ECH lookup selection/handshake behavior depending on scheduling.
findings.remedy: Carry explicit provenance in Answer or a stored-answer variant, assigned while selecting the cache entry under its lock. Both newly started and joined pending resolution remain false regardless of channel readiness.
findings.independent_regression: Force actual new/shared resolution publication before its Answer receiver is consumed, then assert false; stored entry positive true, inline/IP/override false. Add composed bounded HTTPS-record allowance positive when useful without timing-only probabilistic loops or production hooks.

findings.status: confirmed source preservation/doc mismatch; no OS fault injected
findings.title: Non-absence interface lookup failures discard the original OS error
findings.cause: lookup_failed takes &io::Error but reconstructs only kind plus formatted String. Every non-absence Unix/IP Helper lookup failure loses raw OS identity and its original typed cause. source_binding interface_error also replaces error with text at the caller boundary.
findings.consequence: Callers see a readable kind/message but cannot recover the underlying OS code/cause. index rustdoc promises the OS error on lookup failure and the design audit says other failures keep it.
findings.remedy: Return the original OS error where context is unnecessary, or retain it inside a concrete contextual Error owner/source. Preserve it through the source-binding wrapper as well; keep intentionally normalized missing-interface NotFound separate.
findings.independent_regression: Use distinct io::Error::from_raw_os_error sentinels through the contextual wrappers; require original code recoverable in retained typed cause, original category and contextual text. Positive normalized-absence and malformed-name controls remain independent of host failures.
